Confirmed `server.go` doesn't even import `server/runner/memopayload`.

h08.

Two declarers of a `RunOnce` method exist in the codebase:

1. **`server/runner/s3presign.Runner`** — `RunOnce` declared at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43`.
   - **Invoked from production (non-test) code**: yes.
     - Caller 1: `Server.startBackgroundRunners` calls `s3presignRunner.RunOnce(ctx)` directly at `server/server.go:163`.
     - Caller 2: the runner's own continuous loop calls `r.RunOnce(ctx)` on each tick at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`, inside `Runner.Run`, which is itself started as a goroutine from `server/server.go:169`.

2. **`server/runner/memopayload.Runner`** — `RunOnce` declared at `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`.
   - **Invoked from production (non-test) code**: no. A workspace-wide search for `.RunOnce(` finds only the two `s3presign` call sites above; there is no call to `memopayload.NewRunner(...)`, no construction of a `memopayload.Runner`, and no call to its `RunOnce` anywhere in `server/server.go` or elsewhere (it isn't even imported there — see the import list at `server/server.go:1-27`). The only symbol from that package actually used elsewhere is the unrelated standalone function `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload`, called from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` and `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`. No test file references `memopayload` either, so this `RunOnce` declaration currently has no caller at all in the repository.
